elections.name: November 3, 2026 General Election

sources.label: California Secretary of State official voter guide

keyDates.label: Ballots in the mail
keyDates.text: County elections officials begin mailing ballots, and secure ballot drop-off locations open, by this date.
keyDates.quote: County elections officials will begin mailing ballots by October 5. Secure ballot drop-off locations open by October 5.

keyDates.label: Registration deadline
keyDates.text: Last day to register online or by mail (postmark). After this, you can still register conditionally and vote at your county elections office.
keyDates.quote: Online or Postmark by October 19, 2026. You can “conditionally” register and vote at your county elections office after the 15-day voter registration deadline.

keyDates.label: First vote centers open
keyDates.text: The first vote centers open for early in-person voting in counties that use the Voter's Choice Act model.
keyDates.quote: The first vote centers open for early in-person voting in all Voter’s Choice Act counties on October 24.

keyDates.label: Weekend early voting
keyDates.text: In-person early voting locations across California are open on Saturday.
keyDates.quote: In-person early voting locations throughout California will be open on Saturday, October 31.

keyDates.label: Election Day
keyDates.text: Polls are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. Last day to vote in person or return a ballot by 8 p.m. Mailed ballots must be postmarked on or before this day.
keyDates.quote: Polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Mailed ballots must be postmarked on or before November 3. November 3 is the last day to vote in-person or return a ballot by 8:00 p.m.

keyDates.label: Mailed ballots due
keyDates.text: Mailed ballots postmarked by Election Day must reach your county elections office by this date.
keyDates.quote: Mailed ballots: Must be postmarked on or before November 3, 2026, and received by your county elections office no later than November 10, 2026.

elections.keyDatesSource: California Secretary of State, General Election November 3, 2026 page and Election Dates and Resources page, each read twice on Oct 23, 2026.
